people.name: Agrippa
people.line: Tetrarch who heard Paul's defense in Caesarea

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”
translations.bsb: Then Agrippa said to Paul, “Can you persuade me in such a short time to become a Christian?”
translations.kjv: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
translations.asv: And Agrippa said unto Paul, With but little persuasion thou wouldest fain make me a Christian.
